summary: Thomas Heffernan of Lanespark, baptised 1791, son of Patrick Heffernan and Catherine Neagle; not John's ancestor, though once confused with Thomas of Mardyke.
bio: Thomas Heffernan "of Lanespark" was baptised in 1791, a son of Patrick Heffernan and Catherine Neagle. He married Catherine Shelly in 1831. He has sometimes been confused with Thomas Heffernan of Mardyke, born 1808, the husband of Catherine Boney, but the two were different men, and Thomas of Lanespark is not an ancestor of John.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
